context: M22 o6. (Delphine.) W 45th & Seventh. A crowd around a cab with the radio up. Tina at a payphone nearby.

lines.speaker: char.rita_haines
lines.text: Never thought I'd see Times Square this quiet. Listen to that.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Tina's on the payphone. Whispering. With her back to us.

lines.speaker: char.tina_mercado
lines.text: …I told you, Lonnie, Sunday nights. Leave me alone now. Please.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Sunday nights. The club. Rule twelve, Tina. There is no rule twelve.

lines.speaker: char.rita_haines
lines.text: If a President can go down, sugar, anybody can. Anybody.
